audit.title: Bounded development input/reference audit for Calgary and Edmonton
audit.scope: Read-only audit of 25 existing dev cases with city Calgary or Edmonton. The mandated corpus.select('dev') call was used to derive split membership; beyond that selector, only selected dev cases were inspected. No holdout fact/error contents were queried, serialized, or audited. No model outputs generated, prompts tuned, or OpenAI API used.

audit.selection_implementation_note: The prescribed corpus.select('dev') API derives deterministic split membership from the corpus catalog. Only returned dev cases were inspected after selection; no holdout facts, review-focus text, error rows, or attachment bytes were queried or serialized.

denominator.construction: Unmodified evals_dev.data_prompts.gold.gold(case, codes) from the selected dev cases; fact availability uses the existing gold.py text-overlap rule and frozen availability labels.
denominator.fact_availability_warning: Gold text-overlap availability is preserved for reproducibility, but it is not semantic proof that every conjunct is answerable. Graphics, absent attachments, prompt-supplied details, and version mismatches were assessed separately.
denominator.status_counts_meaning: These are human input/reference-support classifications for the original checks, not model correctness, Luna accuracy, or a revised score.
